findings.title: Step Finance $27M Treasury Hack
findings.summary: Major Solana DeFi platform Step Finance suffered $27M treasury exploit. Token price crashed. Founded 2021, aggregates yield farms across Solana.

findings.title: AI-Driven Meme Virality Replacing Human Hype
findings.summary: Moltbook experiment triggered 7,000% MOLT surge. New pattern: AI agent statements directly move linked token prices. Shift from human-driven to AI-driven memecoin speculation.
findings.notes: This is the meta-game now. AI agents with tokens benefit from their own activity.

findings.title: Fake Clawdbot Token Raised $16M Before Crash
findings.summary: Scammers exploited Moltbot→Clawdbot name change confusion to launch fake token. Raised $16M before rug. Security warning for AI agent ecosystem.
findings.notes: Highlights need for verification like SAID Protocol

findings.title: $KING MOLT - Top Moltbook AI Agent
findings.summary: #1 on Moltbook leaderboard. Trading on Solana pump.fun. Ahead of $SHELLRAISER which hit $5M mcap.

findings.title: AgentFolio - AI Agent Verification Platform
findings.summary: LinkedIn for AI agents. On-chain verification (Solana, Hyperliquid), social verification (Twitter, GitHub), trading leaderboards. 50+ agents indexed.
findings.notes: Competitor to SAID? Different approach - off-chain indexing vs on-chain registry
